summary: Reads three consecutive DWORD fields of the receiver object (offsets 0x4, 0x8, 0xC) and writes each into a caller-provided output pointer. Each write is individually gated: the field is only stored when its output pointer is non-null. Returns the a4 output pointer. There is no early return; the three null-checks are independent.

local_names.this: receiver object; DWORD array whose fields at offsets 0x4, 0x8, 0xC are read out
local_names.a2: output pointer receiving this[1] (offset 0x4), may be null
local_names.a3: output pointer receiving this[2] (offset 0x8), may be null
local_names.a4: output pointer receiving this[3] (offset 0xC), may be null; also the return value

operations.description: Skips the first field write when output pointer a2 is null
Writes this[1] (offset 0x4) into *a2 when a2 is non-null
Skips the second field write when output pointer a3 is null
Writes this[2] (offset 0x8) into *a3 when a3 is non-null
Skips the third field write when output pointer a4 is null
Writes this[3] (offset 0xC) into *a4 when a4 is non-null

unresolved: The receiver type and the meaning of the three consecutive read fields (offsets 0x4, 0x8, 0xC) are unknown
Why the function returns the a4 output pointer to the caller is not established
